treaty_name: Convention between the United Kingdom and Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital gains (1980, as amended 1991 and 1996)
eif_quote: UK-Denmark double taxation convention Signed 11 November 1980. Entered into force on 17 December 1980.
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the 1980 UK-Denmark Double Taxation Convention — gov.uk; 1996 Protocol per SI 1996/3165 (legislation.gov.uk)

rates.quote: (b) shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State if the beneficial owner referred to in subparagraph (a) of this paragraph is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent. of the issued share capital of the company paying the dividends.

However, subject to the provisions of Council Directive 90/435/EEC of 23rd July 1990, such dividends: (a) may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent. of the gross amount of the dividends;
Interest arising in a Contracting State which is derived and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State which are derived and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention].

notes: Art. 10 and Art. 12(1)-(2) were replaced by the 1996 Protocol (signed 15 October 1996, SI 1996/3165); per Protocol Art. XI it has effect in the UK from 6 April / 1 April of the calendar year after entry into force and in Denmark from the following income year. Protocol entry into force 20 June 1997 is taken from treaties_merged.json (Danish skat.dk list), not from a text read here, so valid_from 1998-04-06 (later of DK 1998 income year and UK 6 April 1998) is derived. Interest exemption is original 1980 text (effective UK 6 April 1978, DK income year 1978). Dividend 0% tier: company holding directly at least 25% of issued share capital; no holding period; subject to the Parent-Subsidiary Directive reference. MLI: PPT replaces the main-purpose clauses Arts. 10(6), 11(6), 12(5); WHT effect 1 January 2020 per gov.uk page; MLI Art. 8 not in synthesised text. Conflict: the gov.uk country page states the convention 'entered into force on 17 December 1990', while the gov.uk convention text header and treaties_merged.json (skat.dk) give 17 December 1980; 1980 used.
unverified: 1996 Protocol entry-into-force date (1997-06-20) not read from an official text in this run; valid_from 1998-04-06 for dividends/royalties derived from it
